name: Toraware no Tenshi
source:
Heroine gets in a car incident and regains consciousness in a hospital. However, it turns out to be a base of some shady organization and her only option is to try to escape this place.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角遭遇车祸，在一所医院里恢复意识。然而，这里其实是某个可疑组织的基地，她唯一的选择便是设法逃出去。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
